summary.name: AppIconBuilder
summary.one_liner: A Mac app that resizes a source image (JPG, PNG, or PSD) into app icon sets for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Android.
use_cases: Generate iOS and iPadOS app icon sets from one source image
Create a Mac .icns file from a PNG or PSD
Export Android launcher icons from a single artwork file
Add padding, rounded corners, or a background to an icon
summary.what_it_does: The app imports JPG, PNG, and PSD files by drag and drop. It can add padding, rounded corners, and a background to the icon. It exports icons for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Android, including Mac icns files. It can also slice assets and export them. The listing describes it as a tool that generates all icon resolutions for multiple platforms.
notable: Drag-and-drop import of JPG, PNG, and PSD files
Exports iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Android, and icns icon sets
Listed in awesome-mac under Other Tools
caveats: Has In-App Purchases; a $0.99 donate option is listed
Too few ratings to show an overview; the developer has not provided privacy details
